answer: Progressive quotas cap what a new identity can earn until it proves itself. A fresh identity takes 2 tasks per epoch. After 10 honest epochs the quota rises to 8, and after 30 epochs it reaches 20. Each task pays 6 credits, so a new clone earns at most 12 credits per epoch. The ember of early profit is tiny: 1,000 clones earn 12,000 per epoch, while 40 credit stakes lock up 40,000. The bridge to full quota takes 30 epochs, and breakeven needs 34 epochs of perfect honesty. The ledge is the penalty: one proven fake resets the quota to 2 and burns the 40 credit stake.
